desc: Rig steps for 5005 (payloads pinned in tickets/5005-nvme-daily-root.json, evidence/2026-10-25-t6040-5005-payloads.md). A: boot daily v3 SD root (SD64 inserted) on the new daily+NVMe kernel 2234baad + nvmeroot DTB 6d2d3da6, NVMe only enumerates; check SD/WiFi/BT/trackpad/nvme topology; clean poweroff. B: installer 073bb3e1 clones SD64 wallace-root.img to p3 (write-through, SD and other NVMe read-only, writes==p3, clean reboot -f at end), checker + 15 min host deadline. C: nvmeroot 9adabb1b boot; then 3 cold boots with clean poweroff and fsck postcheck. maxcpus=1. Writes only to the pinned exFAT linux partition (CJ 2026-08-03 rule). Stop on any gate failure.
author: claude
